theme_strategy.aesthetic_concept: Linear/Vercel Precision meets Swiss Financial Engineering (Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast with Obsidian Dark mode and crisp Light theme)

hierarchy.badge_text: text-xs font-medium tracking-wide uppercase px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full

typography.anti_default_rules: No Inter for headings. Use Outfit or Cabinet Grotesk style with tight tracking. Numbers and financial values must use monospace font or tabular figures.

visual_enhancers.surface_treatment: Tactical Minimalism with crisp 1px borders (border-border/60). Never use soft muddy drop shadows; use subtle inner highlight or 1px hairline rings.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism_nav: Header and sticky top navigation must use backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/85 border-b border-border/80. NEVER completely transparent.
visual_enhancers.active_indicator: Active sidebar and tab items receive a 2px left border accent or subtle pill indicator bg-primary/10 text-primary border-l-2 border-primary.

shell_structure.sidebar_desktop_width: w-64 shrink-0 border-r border-border/70 bg-card/60 backdrop-blur-md flex flex-col justify-between h-screen sticky top-0
shell_structure.header_height: h-16 border-b border-border/70 px-6 flex items-center justify-between sticky top-0 z-40 bg-background/90 backdrop-blur-md
shell_structure.main_viewport: flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 space-y-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full

grids_and_layouts.bento_dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6
grids_and_layouts.crud_table_container: rounded-xl border border-border/80 bg-card/90 shadow-sm overflow-hidden

multi_currency_config.formatter_rule: Format numbers with proper locale separators and prefix symbol based on active currency setting

instructions_to_main_agent: You are working with React JavaScript (.js/.jsx) files. Do NOT use .tsx or TypeScript annotations in files.
Implement a complete dark/light theme switch toggled from the top header and settings, defaulting to dark mode with smooth CSS transition.
Ensure the top header and dropdowns NEVER have transparent backgrounds (use bg-background/95 or bg-card/95 with backdrop-blur-md and solid border-border).
Provide a working Workspace Switcher in the top header and sidebar top with at least 3 pre-seeded organizations (e.g., 'Acme Global Ventures', 'Nexus Retail Logistics', 'Apex Studio LLC').
Build full functional CRUD for Customers, Products, and Expenses with validation, search filtering, edit modal, delete confirmation dialog, and responsive table views.
Implement rich Invoices module with status filter (All, Paid, Pending, Overdue, Draft) and quick create dialog, plus Inventory module with stock movements and reorder badges.
Dashboard must display live calculated KPIs based on state: Total Revenue, Outstanding Invoices, Total Expenses, Estimated Net Profit, Customer Count, and Product Count.
Include an AI-Powered Business Insights card ('AI Insights Engine' - planned module) with preview recommendations, predictive churn alert, and cashflow forecast prompt.
Ensure multi-currency toggle (USD, EUR, GBP, INR) affects all dashboard metrics, invoice totals, and expense summaries with live currency symbol formatting.

Every interactive element and key text MUST have a descriptive kebab-case 'data-testid' attribute (e.g. data-testid='sidebar-nav-invoices', data-testid='kpi-total-sales', data-testid='create-customer-button', data-testid='theme-toggle-button').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.do_not_center_app: NEVER set text-align: center on .App or main containers. Keep left-aligned natural data flows.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_universal_transition: Do NOT apply universal transition: all. Use targeted transitions on background-color, border-color, and opacity.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.toast_implementation: Use Sonner for toasts with action confirmations (create, edit, delete, workspace switch, currency change).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.empty_states: Include purposeful empty state designs with contextual icon, action button, and descriptive copy.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_raw_emojis: Use Lucide-React icons only. No emoji icons in system navigation or status badges.
